dup_1.instructions: Comparing only `new_intent` and `existing_1` and ignoring every other existing intent, would completing `new_intent` produce essentially the same change to the codebase as completing `existing_1`?

criteria.true: Both intents ask for the same feature, fix or refactor, even if worded differently, or the new intent asks for nothing more than the existing intent already delivers
criteria.false: They ask for different features, fixes or refactors, even if they touch the same area or have similar names or wording

conflict_1_ab.instructions: How do `new_intent` and `existing_1` interact if two agents implement them at the same time on the same codebase?
criteria: Independent: they add or change separate things, neither needs the other, and either can land first
Overlapping but compatible: they edit the same file or function, and the result of landing both still does what both asked
Conflicting: one asks to remove, reverse or contradict something the other adds or requires, so both cannot be satisfied together
